# platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Admin — External Keys

> 6 page(s) of platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Admin under External Keys. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## External Keys

- [Create External Key](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/external_keys/create.md): Identifier of the external key config. A tagged ID prefixed `ekey_`, or — for organizations on the Claude Platform on AWS — the AWS KMS key ARN.
- [Delete External Key](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/external_keys/delete.md): Delete an external key config.
- [Get External Key](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/external_keys/retrieve.md): Identifier of the external key config. A tagged ID prefixed `ekey_`, or — for organizations on the Claude Platform on AWS — the AWS KMS key ARN.
- [List External Keys](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/external_keys/list.md): Identifier of the external key config. A tagged ID prefixed `ekey_`, or — for organizations on the Claude Platform on AWS — the AWS KMS key ARN.
- [Update External Key](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/external_keys/update.md): Identifier of the external key config. A tagged ID prefixed `ekey_`, or — for organizations on the Claude Platform on AWS — the AWS KMS key ARN.
- [Validate External Key](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/external_keys/validate.md): Validate an external key config against the customer's KMS.
